主要内容: On February 22, 2022, the Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) designated several Russian financial institutions under Executive Order (E.O.) 14024, including the State Corporation Bank for Development and Foreign Economic Affairs Vnesheconombank (VEB), Promsvyazbank Public Joint Stock Company, and many of their subsidiaries. Additional institutions were designated on February 24, 2022, such as VTB Bank Public Joint Stock Company, Public Joint Stock Company Bank Financial Corporation Otkritie (Otkritie), Sovcombank Open Joint Stock Company (Sovcombank), and Joint Stock Commercial Bank Novikombank, along with their subsidiaries. These designations blocked all property and interests in property of these entities in the possession or control of U.S. persons, including U.S. financial institutions, or within U.S. jurisdiction. U.S. persons are prohibited from transacting with these entities unless exempt or authorized by OFAC. OFAC issued several general licenses (GLs) to authorize specific transactions, such as GL 2 for servicing obligations of Russian sovereign debt, GL 3 for winding down transactions involving VEB, and GL 11 and 12 for winding down or rejecting transactions involving VTB Bank, Otkritie, and Sovcombank. Other GLs, such as GL 5, 6, 7, 8A, 9A, and 10A, authorize transactions related to international organizations, agricultural commodities, energy, and derivative contracts. OFAC also issued the Russian Harmful Foreign Activities Sanctions Regulations (RuHSR) on March 1, 2022, incorporating GL 5. Transactions for the official business of the Federal Government or the United Nations are exempt from these sanctions.
